verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago, a payments platform, documents an official MCP Server on its own developer site. The server lets an agent in the IDE search official docs, create and fund test users, and configure and monitor webhooks, and a probe confirmed the dedicated MCP server overview page. Missing for 10: documented client connection and authentication setup steps for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Build all your code without leaving the IDE with MCP Server
Search official Mercado Pago documentation without leaving your development environment.
Create test users and manage their funds to validate payment flows.
